description.narrative: The Project provides funding to scale MSME and WMSME lending and is treated as a close-proximity repeat project to MFP-BOP Hamkorbank (#49536) with a focus towards the larger SME segment. The project will have a 35% carve-out to women-owned and led MSMEs and a 10% climate carve-out on a best-effort basis, promoting demonstration and replication effects in Uzbekistan's financial market.

The proposed investment (the Project) entails a senior loan of up to US$100 million to Hamkorbank (the Bank), an IFC investment client since 2001, to support its lending to local MSMEs (of which at least 80% will be SMEs), including WMSMEs, in the Republic of Uzbekistan. The Project comprises an A-loan of up to US$70 million from IFC's own account as well as at least US$30 million to be mobilized under IFC's B-loan program and/or from parallel lenders. A-loan may be reduced to accommodate a larger B-loan, subject to positive market response to syndication efforts. A 35% contractual carve-out of the use of proceeds is designated for WMSMEs, with a best-effort 10% climate target. The A-Loan tenor will be 4 years including 12 months grace period, the tenor of the B-Loans may be shorter subject to lenders appetite.
